'''Bee's Gauntlet''' was a Challenge Mission that ran from 10am PST and until January 4th at 9am PST. == Intro == * [[Optimus Prime]]: ''Bumblebee, do you have a status report on your mission?'' * [[Bumblebee]]: ''Sure do, Optimus. But before I report, you've gotta tell me how things are going out in the Wastelands. Is Megatron wreaking havoc?'' * Optimus Prime: ''Indeed he is, my friend. The Commander was able to handle him, but I fear that it is only temporary.'' * Bumblebee: ''For an Optimus, you're always so pessimistic.'' * Optimus Prime: ''My caution is born from what Megatron said in defeat. He implied that Shockwave was up to something big, and that they would be taking their power to a new level.'' * Bumblebee: ''Well then it's a good thing I got this training challenge ready for the Commander. If you can finish this, you can handle anything Shockwave and Megatron throw at ya! Good luck, it won't be easy, but it will be rewarding!'' == Rewards == '''2-Star Difficulty''' 4000x Premium Bot Crystal Shards 3x Premium Bot Crystals '''3-Star Difficulty''' 10,000x Tier 1 Alpha Spark Essence 1x Tier 1 Alpha Spark 2000x 3-Star Bot Crystal Shards '''
''' 4-Star Difficulty'''''' 5000x Tier 2 Alpha Spark Essence 10,000x Tier 3 Basic Spark Essence 1x Tier 3 Basic Spark 1x 4-Star Bot Crystal == Chapters == === 2-Star: Bee Prepared === === 3-Star: Scout's Honor === === 4-Star: Final Prep === [[Category:Special Missions]]
